verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair axis for a business-filing service, which could plausibly offer recurring or automated filings. The evidence documents only one-off filings, expedited processing tiers, manually requested name-reservation extensions, and an announcements signup, with no recurring schedule. Probes found no API, OpenAPI spec or llms.txt, and the filing host reset the connection, so nothing supports programmatic or scheduled workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
